folds.test_coverage: balanced (each repeat exactly once in test across 4 folds)

denoising.D1_PRIMARY: D1_STRICT_CROSSFIT: pooled within-identity vis2vis; train=leave-one-trial-out; val/test=full-train; predictions inverse-transformed to raw units

rank_rule.selection: smallest rank within 99% of the selected lambda's peak validation score

vis2img_pairing: within-identity, within-split, index-aligned (I0-style); denoised vision -> imagery
refit_policy: train_only (train+validation refit remains a labeled sensitivity, not primary)
metric_definitions: per-voxel Pearson r (Y_true,Y_pred) with explicit constant-voxel accounting; aggregate mean/median/std/min/max/p5/p25/p75/p95, finite fraction, target/prediction/both-constant counts

fold_aggregation.method: arithmetic mean + median + std + min/max across fold-level summaries
fold_aggregation.rule: folds are NOT treated as independent participants; no population-level significance from 4 folds

test_evaluation_policy: each fold's test set evaluated exactly once; no policy changed after seeing test results; a discovered bug is recorded as a protocol deviation and rerun transparently
primary_experiment_matrix: B0 x P1 x V2V-P0 x D1
B1 x P1 x V2V-P0 x D1
